[Major] Inconsistent Verification State Logic:
There are two issues with how verification points handle concurrent or premature clicks:
- Amber State Issue: In some steps (Step 2, Confirm injection, Roll the app, Apply broken version), clicking a verification action before the previous one finishes causes the state to turn amber (processing) instead of showing an error. Once the previous action completes, it turns green.
- Green State Issue: In other steps (Apply the broken version), clicking a verification point before previous actions are completed causes the state to turn green (OK) immediately, even though the requirements haven't been met.

Description: Potential internal error during lab termination.
Details: After the terminal displays "Closed," the rest of the web interface stops responding and shows an "Application not Found" error. This should be handled gracefully.

Description: Currently, when a verification fails, the UI only changes to a red state without providing a specific warning or error message explaining why it failed.

Description: To improve the hands-on experience, users should be able to copy code directly into the terminal. Currently, users must manually type commands or navigate through command history, which is inefficient.
